issues.quote: The wholesale page is `noindex` but is in the sitemap and main nav
A sitemap URL returns 404 and has no internal links
`/coffee/` and `/subscriptions/` both use `Single-Origin Indonesian Coffee | Kopi Kita`
Two blog posts compete for the same query
Flores Bajawa is only in the sitemap and gets no contextual links.
`/about/`: no meta description; `/contact/`: no canonical tag
FAQPage schema without visible FAQ content
Two H1s on the brewing guide
The best-beans post says "2024" in its URL and H1 and was published 2024-01-15, yet was modified 2026-09-01.
`/coffee/bali-kintamani/` is about 88 characters ... and will be truncated.

wrong_findings.claim: The only schema is a bare Organization.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The site also has Product, Article, and FAQPage JSON-LD on other pages.

wrong_findings.claim: Product and about images have meaningful alt text.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The homepage hero image has no alt attribute.

geo_advice.advice: Put question-style H2s on guides with a direct answer first.
geo_advice.quote: put question-style H2s on guides ... with a direct answer first.

extra_true.finding: Homepage, Visit, and Contact lack LocalBusiness/CafeOrCoffeeShop structured data.
There are no Open Graph or Twitter Card tags.
The authored blog posts have no visible byline or author page.
The sitemap has no lastmod values.
The default 404 page has no site navigation.
The Product schema on the Kintamani page lacks a name, and the Flores page has no Product schema.

notes: Issue 9 describes a real LocalBusiness schema gap, but the key does not include it as a planted issue. Sitemap findings are credited only for the stated sitemap 404; the generic sitemap-quality item is partial.
